statement.en: None of this started in 2022. The benchmark against which every AI tutor is still measured — that one-to-one tutoring lifts students two standard deviations above classroom teaching — was published in 1984. Systematic reviews of AI in higher education were being written years before ChatGPT existed.

counterpoint.en: What broke in 2022 was not the idea. It was the scale: a research field became something every student has in their pocket.

note.en: Rendered as a sourced statement rather than a figure: a publication year has no population, and a figure without a population is an impression.

headline.en: AI in education did not begin in 2022

no_faculty_data.en: No survey measures generative-AI adoption faculty by faculty at the University of Luxembourg. Every figure here comes from studies run elsewhere — mostly the United Kingdom and the United States — and describes a discipline, not this institution. Read them as what your field is already living through, not as a measurement of this room.

headline.en: Nobody has measured this at our University.
